svg.text: Single-clock Q-Pix channel | programmable physical phases
The selected analog loop is preserved. One periodic CLK drives the real generator; trim sources emulate backend configuration registers.
Held bit: sample once per cycle
CIN is the external detector capacitance.
FIVE SOURCE-POWER DOMAINS | SERIES FEED + DECOUPLING
Diode bias interfaces; external current seeds remain explicit.
PARAMS | select the code block and press q for the complete simulator defaults.
GUI default: measured room / 10 MHz timing mode; 3 pF / 50 fF; 1.8 V; explicit known analog initial state. Load matching codes/bias before changing temperature.
PHYSICAL CLOCK GENERATION | no external periodic EVAL / CAPTURE / PHASE
